candidate_world.title: Bucătăria românească
candidate_world.description: Descoperă ingrediente și preparate, apoi folosește-le în combinații noi. Perechile surprind ideea unui preparat, nu întreaga rețetă de gătit.

observations: Seven broader scenarios pass again against final emitted assets: old-versus-new request counts, narrow reverse/keyboard/drag, committed/uncommitted recovery trust, live reload/expired restore and31-second server recheck.
Final mobile and320px/200% screenshots were visually inspected. Tried markers and focus remain visible; labels and feedback fit without clipping.
Two identical cached Enter acknowledgments preserve focused visible Cheag alimentar and send no extra combine request.
Following either committed or uncommitted lost-response craft on Apă, focus remains on BODY exactly as in the one-cached-retry control; no backward jump to Cheag occurs.
Normal successful crafting keeps the activated Apă button focused. Escape, next-anchor navigation and collection search retain logical visible focus.

The cached branch now performs synchronous keyboard centering and never creates a deferred pendingFocus ref. No extra state counter, request, mutation or save write was introduced for that acknowledgement.

resolved_findings.finding: Repeated identical cached feedback left pendingFocus stale and caused a later recovery to focus a previous ingredient.
resolved_findings.status: Resolved by source inspection and six fresh controlled browser journeys; before evidence retained in cached-focus-probe/.

limits: Lost-response recovery still leaves focus on BODY, matching the previous one-cached control; retaining focus on the newly activated partner remains a separate improvement.
Observations last only in the bounded live session and revalidate after30seconds; portable successful discoveries remain unchanged.
Automated browser review is not physical-device or human enjoyment acceptance.
This final review supersedes earlier GUI acceptance for the changed frontend source; original evidence remains historical.
